focusedCheck.reference: Actual Java 25 native painting/carving/post/floating/cave decoration, IrisDepositModifier, EngineMantle.insertMatter, IrisDecorantActuator, floating decorateColumns and IrisPerfectionModifier. The JVM host exports only selected probes; the actual-Wasm worker/client result is inspected at those positions.
focusedCheck.probeSelection: Five terrain/air/bedrock controls, four native single-block deposits collected from three bounded horizontal bands, two surface/floating flower positions. No full-volume comparison or parameter matrix.
